publication_override.reason: The owner made publishing validated versions without device testing a standing rule.
publication_override.scope: installation and use on the owner's own Windows computer

not_validated: No person has installed or used 1.2.0 on a real Windows PC; only the GitHub windows-latest runner installed it silently, ran --smoke and the start-up probe, and uninstalled it.
Custom themes, fonts, text and corner scales were seen only in host screenshots; many hard-coded radii and colours do not follow every setting.
The headphone EQ was not heard on real headphones; Java Sound device names (DirectSound) were not checked for truncation or stability on real hardware, nor unplugging mid-playback.
The output picker cannot link a profile to the system default output, because Java Sound does not name it.
The Ketmix loop bridge was rendered in tests only; no person listened to it on Windows.

The lyrics editor was not used with a keyboard and real playback by a person; a whole-shell test with the editor preview open raised a Compose test-harness layout error that was not reproduced in the running app.
Layout and appearance sync between a real phone and Windows through the live account was not tried.
Upgrading a real 1.1.0 installation to 1.2.0 (MSI major upgrade or the in-app updater) was not tried.
The MSI is not code-signed; Windows SmartScreen will warn about an unknown publisher.
known_limitations: Library pre-separation follows the phone's rules only on mains power; streaming separation ahead of the playhead is not ported to Windows.
No light/dark/system theme choice on Windows: the window follows Windows.
No recap soundtrack and no Ketogether host controls on Windows (neither feature exists there).
The album header still fits its Canvas instead of using the artwork-by-format rule.
The phone is only reachable for phone control while its app is open or playing.

features_1_2.personalisation: shared ThemeColors/Appearance/Personalization: custom colours through ThemeGuard (WCAG AA), presets and KT1. codes, five fonts from the app's .ttf files, text scale 85-130 %, corner scale on Ket27Desk.Radius, list density on title rows; defaults give the 1.1.0 look exactly
features_1_2.lyrics: shared KaraokeDraw and LyricsBlur in the desktop lyrics (feathered fill, living held notes, blur of far lines) and every lyrics style setting
features_1_2.artwork: player artwork and Canvas at the height of their own shape (shared PlayerArtworkMath); the windowed player's Canvas fills its column edge to edge, its foot fading into the background
features_1_2.lyrics_editor: shared LyricsDraft; line or word timing on the heard position, keyboard (Space, arrows, Ctrl+Z, Ctrl+S, Esc), preview, save through CustomLyrics, LRC/enhanced LRC export
features_1_2.layout: the phone's layout keys read for the window: sidebar entries, Home sections, player-bar buttons (2-5, queue required), library grid/list and opening order, title menu order; empty values give the 1.1.0 layout
features_1_2.settings_search: shared SettingsMatch; scrolls to the section and highlights the row
features_1_2.playlist_updates: shared PlaylistFollow; checked every six hours and three minutes after a remote change; offered in a card
features_1_2.headphone_eq: shared Biquad, HeadphoneProfile, EqCascade, HeadphoneLinks; imported parametric profiles linked per Windows output (key btn:+digest of the device name, valid on the phone), after the decks and voice level, before the ten-band equaliser, safe preamp, 60 ms crossfade
features_1_2.audio_output: Java Sound devices able to play 48 kHz stereo, live switch with fades, remembered by name, default while it is missing
features_1_2.ketmix: LoopFx on each deck before the time-stretch, the Bridge style planned (loopedLast tracked) and rendered with GlideDriver on both decks, lyric-aware voice facts, beat model frame count read from the ONNX input
features_1_2.lyrics_order: the lyrics source order setting in Settings
